clips.speaker: Maddie Jow
clips.title: 美银Maddie Jow：AI算力需求激增，中国电力需求将翻三倍
title_lines: 中国电力需求将翻三倍

subtitles.en: We recently see government talking about 2 trillion RMB to be invest into the AI areas as well. I think this will be probably through the telecom company, through the internet company, and also through a lot of the government funding as well.
subtitles.zh: 我们最近看到政府讨论投入2万亿元人民币到AI领域。我认为这可能会通过电信公司、互联网公司以及大量政府资金来实现。

subtitles.en: What about the power needs? I think do you think the market is still underestimating the power needs that we need when it comes to some of these AI areas? How do you model that sort of?
subtitles.zh: 那么电力需求呢？你认为市场是否仍然低估了AI领域所需的电力？你如何建模？

subtitles.en: Yeah, sure. If you look at like MVDS models from 2022, through the potential 2028 models, we expect that the debt density to increase 100 times. So that means you basically need a lot more power to support that as well.
subtitles.zh: 是的。如果你看从2022年到2028年的MVDS模型，我们预计算力密度将增加100倍。这意味着你需要更多的电力来支持。

subtitles.en: So from a power perspective, we are expecting power demand at least to triple in the next five years as well. Similarly in China, we also need to build a lot of the power equipment together with the global as well.
subtitles.zh: 从电力角度看，我们预计未来五年电力需求至少翻三倍。同样在中国，我们也需要与全球同步建设大量电力设备。

subtitles.en: So we are also seeing various new trends on the power, including like transformer, gas turbine, ESS, power storage, et cetera.
subtitles.zh: 我们还看到电力领域的新趋势，包括变压器、燃气轮机、储能系统等。

clips.speaker_context: Co-head of China equity research and head of APAC basic materials, oil and gas research at BofA Global Research

clips.speaker: Maddie Jow
clips.title: 美银Maddie Jow：AI基建拉动电网设备出口，中国电网投资年增两位数
title_lines: AI基建拉动电网设备出口
中国电网投资年增两位数

subtitles.en: Yeah, so for ESS upstream, of course you have lithium, midstream, you have CATL, and some of the other battery names as well. And downstream probably like Sungrove, Tesla, these are the major, you know, the ESS producers.
subtitles.zh: 对于储能系统，上游有锂，中游有宁德时代等电池企业，下游有阳光电源、特斯拉等主要储能系统生产商。

subtitles.en: And ESS order has been very, very strong year today as well. You alluded to some of this earlier about the build out in China.
subtitles.zh: 今年储能订单非常强劲。你之前提到了中国的建设。

subtitles.en: In terms of the data center building, what is the downstream impact perhaps on construction, on industrial growth as well? Yeah, so we are actually seeing a lot of the construction and industrial growth that are very lean towards the AI growth.
subtitles.zh: 数据中心建设对下游建筑和工业增长有何影响？我们看到许多建筑和工业增长都倾向于AI增长。

subtitles.en: For example, the great investments. We are actually seeing this five years government policies, great investment compared to the previous five years to grow by 40%. And this year we are expecting a great investment to grow by double digit as well.
subtitles.zh: 例如电网投资。我们看到这五年政府政策下的电网投资相比前五年增长了40%。今年我们预计电网投资也将实现两位数增长。

subtitles.en: So that benefiting a lot of the great players, at the same time China is also trying to export a lot of our equipment on the on the on the power side, like for example, transformer gas turbine related.
subtitles.zh: 这使许多电网企业受益，同时中国也在努力出口大量电力设备，例如变压器、燃气轮机等。

clips.speaker_context: Co-head of China equity research and head of APAC basic materials, oil and gas research at BofA Global Research

clips.speaker: Maddie Jow
clips.title: 美银Maddie Jow：下调布油预测至70美元，明年供应过剩但需求结构性受损
title_lines: 明年供应过剩但需求结构性受损

subtitles.en: I know you guys just lowered your forecast for Brent just a few days ago. But so, tell us a little bit more about how quickly do you think flows can actually normalize in the straight-up?
subtitles.zh: 我知道你们几天前下调了布伦特原油预测。那么你认为供应流能多快恢复正常？

subtitles.en: Yeah. So, yes, we lower our Brent oil forecast to about $70 for second half and also next year as well. We are still expecting a small deficit for the Q3 because of still takes time for the flow to normalize and then also for the volume to arrive in Asia as well.
subtitles.zh: 是的，我们将布伦特原油下半年和明年的预测下调至约70美元。我们仍预计三季度出现小幅短缺，因为供应流正常化和原油运抵亚洲需要时间。

subtitles.en: However, into next year we believe it will turn into surplus again, want this flow come in. One of the key reason, of course, the demand is quite weak as well.
subtitles.zh: 然而，到明年，随着供应流入，我们认为将再次转为过剩。关键原因之一是需求相当疲弱。

subtitles.en: If you look at last month's China data, actually input was down 30 percent on oil perspective. Some of them is because of using strategic reference or commercial reserve. But I think also we are expecting that the demand was probably down around 10 percent of the real demands just on that one month's perspective.
subtitles.zh: 看上月中国数据，原油进口下降了30%。部分原因是动用战略储备或商业库存。但我们也认为，仅就一个月而言，实际需求可能下降了约10%。

subtitles.en: Some demand may be able to come back, like for example, some chemical demands. But some demand was actually permanently replaced by using more electric truck or EVs and also turning to co-chemical, etc. So, you're saying some of it is structural. Yeah.
subtitles.zh: 部分需求可能恢复，例如化工需求。但一些需求已被电动卡车、电动汽车以及转向煤化工等永久替代。所以你说部分是结构性的。是的。

subtitles.en: I think next year, yes. That's what we are expecting next year. It will be a surplus. However, for the rest of this year, I think market don't need to panic that much first because at the end of the day, we have already run down inventory for more than three months, right?
subtitles.zh: 我认为明年是的，我们预计明年将出现过剩。但今年剩余时间，市场不必过于恐慌，因为我们已经消耗库存超过三个月了。

clips.speaker_context: Co-head of China equity research and head of APAC basic materials, oil and gas research at BofA Global Research

clips.speaker: Maddie Jow
clips.title: 美银Maddie Jow：黄金牛市是否结束？取决于央行购金和美元走势
title_lines: 取决于央行购金和美元走势

subtitles.en: Gold. I have to ask you, we briefly dipped below 4,000. Right now, I mean, is this rally, this bull market that we're seeing gold, do you think it's over, given the fact that there are a lot of concerns about the strength of the dollar now?
subtitles.zh: 黄金。我们短暂跌破了4000美元。现在，你认为黄金的涨势、牛市是否结束了？考虑到目前对美元走强的担忧。

subtitles.en: I think compared to like other metals like aluminum and copper, gold in our view, it's more of a belief, right? And then also, so compared to copper, you don't have that much actual need like building the grid, like the ESS, et cetera.
subtitles.zh: 我认为与其他金属如铝和铜相比，黄金更多是一种信仰。与铜相比，黄金没有那么多实际需求，如电网建设、储能系统等。

subtitles.en: So, gold is more like whether the rate hike, strong US dollar, et cetera. So, in the near term, I think clients are quite concerned on gold as well.
subtitles.zh: 所以黄金更多受加息、美元走强等因素影响。短期内，我认为客户对黄金也很担忧。

subtitles.en: Also, another thing that will impact is central bank buying. We started to see China central bank buying in a gradual phases. So, it really depends on at what level, maybe Chinese central bank or some other central bank will come up to buy.
subtitles.zh: 另一个影响因素是央行购金。我们开始看到中国央行分阶段购金。所以这取决于在什么价位，中国央行或其他央行会入场购买。

subtitles.en: Otherwise, from a dollar, from a yield, from a rate cut perspective, probably is losing the momentum to upside.
subtitles.zh: 否则，从美元、收益率、降息角度看，可能失去上行动力。

clips.speaker_context: Co-head of China equity research and head of APAC basic materials, oil and gas research at BofA Global Research

clips.speaker: Maddie Jow
clips.title: 美银Maddie Jow：铜供应紧张，AI和电网建设支撑需求

subtitles.en: Many can I ask you as well. What sort of assumptions you might be making on the UN for the back half of the year and how that informs commodity prices overall?
subtitles.zh: 我还想问，你对下半年美联储政策有何假设？这如何影响整体大宗商品价格？

subtitles.en: Yeah, so I would say that we are, so our house view is actually US to have 75 bips rate hike for the next 12 months. And then we are also expecting US dollar quite strong as well.
subtitles.zh: 我们的内部观点是，美国未来12个月将加息75个基点。同时我们预计美元将相当强劲。

subtitles.en: So, as a whole, it wouldn't benefit overall metals, apart from the, but of course, some of the metals may stand out from a supply demand perspective, like I said, copper, probably will stand out from a supply demand because very tight supply.
subtitles.zh: 总体而言，这对整体金属不利，但一些金属可能因供需面脱颖而出，比如铜，供应非常紧张。

subtitles.en: And then also, we are still having some very good support on the demand, like the greed building, the AI building as well.
subtitles.zh: 同时，需求仍有很好的支撑，比如电网建设和AI建设。

clips.speaker_context: Co-head of China equity research and head of APAC basic materials, oil and gas research at BofA Global Research
